challenge.method: Follow the spec branches for a nil slice, a string, a non-nil zero-length slice, and a subsequent append with insufficient capacity. Check whether the full slice form introduces a new allocation rule.
challenge.results: The nil result follows its own clause, a string result falls outside the claim, and length zero adds no exception for a non-nil slice. Full slice bounds may limit capacity. A later append can allocate a different underlying array.

limitations: The condition assumes a valid slice expression and concerns the result at slicing time. Capacity, pointer identity for zero-size elements, and later allocation are separate questions.
